title: Filter BigQuery Reservations by Group
summary: The BigQuery Reservation API's `projects.locations.reservations.list` method now supports an optional `filter` parameter. This allows developers to retrieve reservations specifically by their associated reservation group.
details: You can now refine your reservation listings using the new `filter` query parameter on `projects.locations.reservations.list`. This optional string parameter currently supports filtering by `reservation_group`. For example, you can use `filter="reservation_group=my-group"` to fetch all reservations belonging to 'my-group'. This addition provides more granular control when managing your BigQuery reservations programmatically.
